notes: HS and district Wikipedia agree; district logo confirms purple. Black/grey in logo is outline/shading.

identified_as: Bald Eagle-Nittany High School, Mill Hall (Keystone Central SD)
era: Closed 1999/2000; merged with Lock Haven HS into Central Mountain HS (royal blue/white).
evidence: Retry: Wikipedia raw infobox 'colours = Black and White', mascot Panther (confirmed). No yearbook on e-yearbook.com found; web and Bing image searches returned nothing from the school's era. No image looked at, so no hex. Did not use Central Mountain's colours.

identified_as: Lower Paxton Township High School (Dauphin County)
era: Replaced by Central Dauphin HS (green and white, Rams) when it opened in 1955.
notes: Colours from alma mater text only (printed in 1946, 1951 and 1955 Ranger yearbooks); no hex. Mascot from yearbook title and 'Lower Paxton Rangers' newspaper mentions. Not Lower Dauphin (also blue/white, different school).
evidence: 1955 Ranger yearbook OCR: alma mater "We hail thee, Alma Mater, Our gallant white and blue"; same book notes the new school band would wear green and white (Central Dauphin). No colour image could be viewed (e-yearbook images blocked). Retry: search snippets show the same white-and-blue alma mater on 1946 and 1951 yearbook pages; no colour image reachable.

Class colours (blue and silver 1951, green and silver 1952) are class-only. No colour image viewable.
